areas.name: NRC
areas.note: A section of the West Rogers Winter Restricted Area is closed due to ski tracks accessing the Macdonald Winter Prohibited Area from the WRA

parking.name: Beaver Parking
parking.note:
To park your vehicle in this area, you must display a valid Winter Parking Permit and national park pass in your vehicle.
Winter Permits are now required for all backcountry access. You must carry a valid Winter Permit on your person.
A Beaver Overnight Parking Permit is available at the Rogers Pass Discovery Centre for skiers wishing to overnight in adjacent Winter Unrestricted Areas.
